==English== [[File:Charles Bond Park 1.JPG|right|thumb|Charles Bond Park, [[w:Yinnar, Victoria|Yinnar]], [[Victoria]], [[Australia]]]] {{wp}} ===Etymology=== {{ety|en|:inh|enm:park|tree=1}} From {{inh|en|enm|park}}, from {{der|en|fro|parc|t=livestock pen}}, from {{der|en|la-med|parcus}}, {{m|la|parricus}}, from {{der|en|frk|*parruk|*parrik|t=enclosure, pen, fence}}. Cognate with {{cog|nl|perk|t=enclosure; flowerbed}}, {{cog|goh|pfarrih}}, {{m|goh|pferrih|t=enclosure, pen}}, {{cog|ang|pearroc|t=enclosure}} (whence modern {{cog|en|paddock}}), {{cog|non|parrak}}, {{m|non|parak|t=enclosure, pen; distress, anxiety}}, {{cog|is|parraka|t=to keep pent in under restraint and coercion}}. More at {{l|en|parrock}}, {{l|en|paddock}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{enPR|pärk}}, {{IPA|en|/pɑɹk/}} ** {{IPA|en|[pʰɑɹk]|a=US}} *** {{audio|en|en-us-park.ogg|a=US}} ** {{IPA|en|[pɑɹk]|a=Philippines}} * {{IPA|en|/pɑːk/|[pʰɑː(ʔ)k]|a=UK}} * {{IPA|en|[pʰɐːk]|a=Australia,New Zealand}} ** {{audio|en|en-au-park.ogg|a=AU}} * {{IPA|en|[pʰaːk]|a=Boston}} * {{IPA|en|[pʰɒək]|a=NYC}} * {{IPA|en|/pɐk/|a=Ghana}} * {{rhymes|en|ɑː(ɹ)k|s=1}} ===Noun=== {{en-noun}} # {{senseid|en|Q22698}} An area of land set aside for environment preservation or recreation. #: {{cot|en|campground#Noun|camp#Noun|encampment#Noun}} ## A tract of ground kept in its natural state, about or adjacent to a residence, such as for the preservation of game, for walking, riding, or the like. ##: {{ux|en| She went to the '''park''' for a jog with him.}} ##* '''17th century''', {{w|Edmund Waller}}, ''At Penshurst'' ## A piece of ground in or near a city or town, enclosed and kept for ornament and recreation. ##: {{ux|en|Hyde '''Park''' in London;  Central '''Park''' in New York}} ##* {{RQ:Maxwell Mirror and the Lamp|chapter=23|passage=If the afternoon was fine they strolled together in the '''park''', very slowly, and with pauses to draw breath wherever the ground sloped upward. The slightest effort made the patient cough.}} ##* {{quote-book|en|year=1994|author=Robert Ferro|title=The Blue Star |passage=I roamed the streets and '''parks''', as far removed from the idea of art and pretense as I could take myself, discovering there the kind of truth I was supposed to be setting down on paper…}} ## An enclosed parcel of land stocked with animals for hunting, which one may have by prescription or royal grant. # {{lb|en|US}} A wide, flat-bottomed valley in a mountainous region. #* {{quote-book|en|title=Geology and Mining Industries of the Cripple Creek District, Colorado|page=54|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=QXbnAAAAMAAJ|author=Whitman Cross; Richard Alexander Fullerton Penrose|year=1895|passage=High '''Park''' is a depression of 10 or 12 square miles in extent {{...}} at a general elevation of 7,500 feet. Its smooth floor is partly due to volcanic tuff of the western volcanic area, but chielfly to a find lake-bed deposit of yellowish sandstone....}} # An area used for specific purposes. ## An open space occupied by or reserved for vehicles, [[materiel|matériel]] or stores. ##: {{ux|en|a wagon '''park''';   an artillery '''park'''}} ## A partially enclosed [[basin]] in which [[oyster]]s are grown. ## An area [[zone]]d for a particular (industrial or commercial) purpose. ##: {{ux|en|business '''park''';  industrial '''park''';  science '''park'''}} ##* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-06-21|author=[http://guardian.co.uk/profile/chico-harlan/ Chico Harlan] |volume=189|issue=2|page=30|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly |title=[http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2013/jun/18/japan-solar-energy-fukushima-nuclear-renewable-abe Japan pockets the subsidy …] |passage=Across Japan, technology companies and private investors are racing to install devices that until recently they had little interest in: solar panels.
